C1417.title: Deus Finance 2022 Oracle Manipulation Attack
C1417.summary: On March 15, 2022, Deus Finance suffered a flash-loan and price-oracle manipulation attack. The attacker distorted the quoted price of a DEI-related trading pair, causing the protocol to value collateral incorrectly and release funds. Public reporting estimated the loss at about $3 million, and later oracle-manipulation research discussed the incident as a real-world attack sample.
